import_summary.note: Whole-file accepted/rejected game counts from the source adapter. They are not a per-player missing rate; rejected games are simply not counted for anyone.

scope.events: PICK events of accepted games only; role is the role played in that game
scope.identity: exact (source team ID, player ID); no name matching or cross-team sums
scope.patch: games on the reference roster patch only
scope.recent: latest 20 unique games per player, source team and role
